## Ops: Monitor (must be ACTIVE)
Every 15 minutes: six health checks. Emails only when an alert changes state (or as a reminder every 4h while still firing), and sends RESOLVED when it clears. Runbook paths in the emails are runbooks/*.md in each project.

parameters.query:
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM ai_calls WHERE outcome = 'failed' AND created_at > now() - interval '1 hour')::int AS ai_failed_1h,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM ai_calls WHERE outcome = 'invalid_output' AND created_at > now() - interval '6 hours')::int AS invalid_6h,
  (SELECT coalesce(string_agg(DISTINCT automation_id, ', '), '') FROM ai_calls
    WHERE outcome = 'budget_exceeded' AND created_at >= current_date) AS over_budget,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM review_queue WHERE status = 'pending' AND created_at < now() - interval '24 hours')::int AS reviews_overdue,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM runs WHERE outcome = 'failed' AND created_at > now() - interval '1 hour')::int AS runs_failed_1h,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM workflow_errors WHERE created_at > now() - interval '1 hour')::int AS errors_1h;
SELECT name, state, last_notified FROM alerts;

INSERT INTO alerts (name, state, since, last_notified, detail)
VALUES ($1, $2, now(), CASE WHEN $3::boolean THEN now() END, $4)
ON CONFLICT (name) DO UPDATE SET
  since = CASE WHEN alerts.state <> EXCLUDED.state THEN now() ELSE alerts.since END,
  state = EXCLUDED.state,
  last_notified = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.last_notified, alerts.last_notified),
  detail = EXCLUDED.detail;
